description: Get an Amazon product's title, price and availability by ASIN or search term. Look up an Amazon product by ASIN or search term: title, current price, availability, rating, review count and main image, returned as structured data. Requests exit through a residential IP with a real browser, since Amazon rejects datacenter traffic. For agents tracking prices, monitoring competitors or verifying a listing before a purchase decision. — $0.020000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "search amazon for a product", "get the price of this amazon item", "amazon product by asin".
name: amazon
